packageRules.description: Automerge major updates too for runtime deps (package.json "dependencies"): they're covered by the >=95% unit/e2e coverage gate, unlike dev tooling, Docker base images, Helm charts, or GitHub Actions, where a green CI run doesn't actually exercise the new version's behavior. Left ungrouped (one PR per package) so a bad major is easy to bisect.
Don't manage the chart's own image: tag defaults to "" and resolves via appVersion, so pinning it to a digest here breaks that default
